replay_verification.principle: Any third party reads the attestation from a public RPC and byte-compares it to the published root.
steps: 1. Take attestation UID from the attest() receipt (Attested event topic[1])
3. Decode data with SchemaEncoder('bytes32,bytes32,uint64'); assert rootSha256 == f1913ecaae4ea18ac113d341c1b050318cec4c49dcda440dacbbadb89eca1b4e
4. Independently fetch https://councilof.ai/root.json, sha256 the bytes, assert equality
5. Explorer: https://etherscan.io/tx/<hash> (status == 1) and https://easscan.org/address/<UID> attestation page
6. Record tx hash + UID in interop/root-witness-latest.json witnesses.eas_ethereum (ATTESTED)
